input.code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# flanged bushing, z along turning axis
nose_d0 = 20.0      # tapered nose, bottom
nose_d1 = 24.0      # tapered nose, top
nose_len = 6.0
flange_d = 44.0
flange_len = 5.0
body_d = 28.0
body_len = 11.0
chamfer = 1.0       # 45° top chamfer
bore_d = 18.0       # counterbore from bottom
bore_depth = 4.0
thru_d = 12.0

z_flange = nose_len
z_body = z_flange + flange_len
z_cham = z_body + body_len
length = z_cham + chamfer

nose = (cq.Workplane("XY").circle(nose_d0 / 2)
        .workplane(offset=nose_len).circle(nose_d1 / 2).loft().tag("nose.side"))
flange = (cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=z_flange)
          .circle(flange_d / 2).extrude(flange_len).tag("flange.rim"))
body = (cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=z_body)
        .circle(body_d / 2).extrude(body_len).tag("body.side"))
cham = (cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=z_cham).circle(body_d / 2)
        .workplane(offset=chamfer).circle(body_d / 2 - chamfer).loft().tag("body.chamfer"))
solid = nose.union(flange).union(body).union(cham)

cbore = (cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=-1.0)
         .circle(bore_d / 2).extrude(bore_depth + 1.0).tag("counterbore.wall"))
bore = (cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=bore_depth)
        .circle(thru_d / 2).extrude(length - bore_depth + 1.0).tag("bore.wall"))
result = solid.cut(cbore).cut(bore)
